transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, nice to meet you too. Um, I guess what made me come in is that... well, after work or class, I’ll sit down with my laptop and just end up eating a really huge amount of food. Like, I'll finish a whole takeout meal, plus chips, sweets, and pretty much whatever snacks are in my desk drawer. It's just way more than I ever planned to eat, and it's definitely more than I’d ever eat around anyone else.
After these eating episodes, do you ever make yourself vomit?
No, I don't do that. Um, I've never made myself throw up or anything like that. I just kind of sit there feeling really uncomfortably full afterwards, but no, I don't vomit.
When these eating episodes happen, do you feel unable to stop or control how much you’re eating?

Yeah, definitely. Once I start, it really feels like I can't stop. It's almost like I’m just watching myself keep reaching for the next thing. Even while it's happening, I’ll be thinking to myself, Jaime, stop, you have a budget report to finish... and I’m not even enjoying the food anymore at that point. But I just can't seem to make myself stop.
After these episodes, do you ever try to make up for the eating by fasting, exercising a lot, or using laxatives or diet pills?

No, I don't do any of that either. I don't use laxatives or pills, and I definitely don't exercise a lot or fast. I just kind of deal with feeling awful and guilty about it, but I don't try to... undo it, I guess.
During these episodes, do you eat much more quickly than you normally do?

I don't think so. I mean, I'm not really sure if I eat faster than usual. I guess I've never really paid attention to my speed when it's happening. I'm usually just so focused on the food and feeling like I can't stop.
When these episodes happen, do you usually eat alone because you feel embarrassed about how much you’re eating?

Yeah, I do. I usually... I've been waiting until my roommate is out of the apartment, or until my family has gone to bed. I'm just really embarrassed for anyone to see how much I can eat. Especially because, you know, during the day I act so put-together and health-conscious. So I definitely make sure I'm alone when it happens.
Do these eating episodes cause you a lot of distress?
Yeah, they really do. I mean, like I mentioned earlier, I feel really awful and guilty after it happens. It definitely upsets me a lot to be dealing with this.
